title: Baby Lion Roar
blurb: A lion cub attempting a roar and producing something nearer to a squeaky yawn. Lions cannot manage the real thing until they are around two years old, so this is very much a work in progress, and it is adorable in exactly the way a full-grown roar is not. Perfect for anybody putting up a fight they cannot possibly win. A small dog. A toddler. A colleague objecting to a decision that was finalised last week and signed off on Tuesday.
origin: A recording of a lion cub's early attempt at roaring.
